clients.name: Villa Ermellina
clients.rational:
In October 2026 Meta spend amounted to 705,47 €, with the budget down 55% compared with September 2026.
In the comparison period spend had been 1.553,95 €.
On Instagram, accounts reached fall to 216.968 (-52%), views to 505.032 (-53%), interactions to 38.196 (-20%) and clicks to 2.158 (-67%).
On Facebook, accounts reached fall to 342.133 (-57%), views to 596.886 (-65%), interactions to 63.032 (-31%) and clicks to 4.492 (-59%).
These declines should be read in the light of the lower budget allocated in the month, higher platform costs (CPM) and stronger competition in the hospitality sector during the period.
Management included daily monitoring of spend, selection of placements and creative rotation to limit audience fatigue.
Work on balancing Instagram and Facebook continued according to the return of each placement.
In the comparison period accounts reached on Instagram were 451.956.
Coverage of the target audience continues in the coming months, with attention to the return on the available budget.
